name: Copay Compass
author: Marc Saint-Jour
summary: Finds cancer-drug copay programs, tracks fund reopenings, and prepares application materials for the patient to submit.
starterPrompt: Help me find verified copay assistance options for [drug] in [state] with [insurance type].
usageNote: Use for program research, not medical or financial advice. Verify eligibility rules with the program and never share sensitive identifiers.
